name: AppsFlyer (Actions)
description: Send mobile app events to AppsFlyer for attribution and marketing analytics.

s2sToken.label: S2S Token
s2sToken.description: Your AppsFlyer S2S token, used to authenticate in-app events. Find it in the AppsFlyer dashboard under Account Settings > API tokens. This is not the same as your Dev Key.

devKey.label: Dev Key
devKey.description: Your AppsFlyer Dev Key, found in the AppsFlyer dashboard under App Settings. Used only to sign Application Installed and Application Opened events. Not required if you only send in-app events.

appleAppID.label: Apple App ID
appleAppID.description: Your iOS App ID, without the `id` prefix. Required to send events from iOS devices.

androidAppID.label: Android App ID
androidAppID.description: Your Android package name. Required to send events from Android devices.

rokuAppID.label: Roku App ID
rokuAppID.description: Your Roku App ID. Required to send events from Roku devices.

trackEvent.title: Track In-App Event
trackEvent.description: Send an in-app event to AppsFlyer. Note that server-side events are always classified as organic in AppsFlyer.
trackEvent.defaultSubscription: type = "track" and event != "Application Installed" and event != "Application Opened"

appsflyer_id.label: AppsFlyer ID
appsflyer_id.description: The AppsFlyer device identifier. If omitted, the advertising ID is used, then the User ID, then the Anonymous ID.

device_type.label: Device Type
device_type.description: The device platform. Must be `ios`, `android` or `roku`.

event_value.label: Event Properties
event_value.description: Properties of the event. Serialized to a JSON string with all values quoted, as AppsFlyer requires. A `revenue` property is sent as `af_revenue`.

event_currency.label: Currency
event_currency.description: The currency of any revenue value, as an ISO 4217 code. Defaults to USD.

uid.label: User ID
uid.description: Your own identifier for the user.

anonymous_id.label: Anonymous ID
anonymous_id.description: The Segment anonymous ID, used as a fallback identifier.

os_version.label: OS Version
os_version.description: The device OS version. Required by AppsFlyer for iOS in-app events.

advertising_id.label: Advertising ID
advertising_id.description: The device advertising ID. Sent as `idfa` on iOS and `advertising_id` on Android and Roku.

device_id.label: Device ID
device_id.description: The iOS vendor identifier, used when the advertising ID is unavailable or zeroed out.

bundle_id.label: Bundle ID
bundle_id.description: The app bundle identifier. Sent for iOS only.

att.label: ATT Status
att.description: The iOS App Tracking Transparency status. Sent for iOS only.

counter.label: App Open Counter
counter.description: The historical number of times the app has been opened by this user.

referrer.label: Referrer
referrer.description: The Google Play store referrer. Sent for Android and Roku only.

consent_data.label: Consent Data
consent_data.description: Consent information to forward to AppsFlyer.

applicationInstalled.title: Application Installed
applicationInstalled.description: Report a first app open to AppsFlyer as an install.

appsflyer_id.label: AppsFlyer ID
appsflyer_id.description: The AppsFlyer device identifier. If omitted, the advertising ID is used.

device_type.label: Device Type
device_type.description: The device platform. Must be `ios`, `android` or `roku`.

timestamp.label: Timestamp
timestamp.description: When the event occurred. Required — this value is part of the request signature.

ip.label: IP Address
ip.description: The device IP address. Required — this value is part of the request signature.

locale.label: Locale
locale.description: The device locale. Required — this value is part of the request signature.

advertising_id.label: Advertising ID
advertising_id.description: The device advertising ID. Sent as `idfa` on iOS and `advertising_id` on Android and Roku.

device_id.label: Device ID
device_id.description: The iOS vendor identifier, used when the advertising ID is unavailable or zeroed out.

ad_tracking_enabled.label: Ad Tracking Enabled
ad_tracking_enabled.description: Whether the user has allowed ad tracking. Sent to AppsFlyer as the `aie` flag.

device_model.label: Device Model
device_model.description: The device model, sent to AppsFlyer as `type`.

bundle_id.label: Bundle ID
bundle_id.description: The app bundle identifier. Sent for iOS only.

att.label: ATT Status
att.description: The iOS App Tracking Transparency status. Sent for iOS only.

uid.label: User ID
uid.description: Your own identifier for the user.

anonymous_id.label: Anonymous ID
anonymous_id.description: The Segment anonymous ID, used as a fallback identifier.

campaign.label: Apple Search Ads Campaign
campaign.description: Campaign attribution, mapped to AppsFlyer's Apple Search Ads fields. Sent for iOS only.

fb_cookie.label: Facebook Cookie
fb_cookie.description: The Facebook cookie associated with this user.

cid.label: Customer User ID
cid.description: Your customer user ID. AppsFlyer prefers this over the User ID when both are present.

deeplink.label: Deeplink
deeplink.description: The full deeplink URL that opened the app.

custom_data.label: Custom Data
custom_data.description: Additional custom data to forward to AppsFlyer.

asa_data.label: Apple Search Ads Data
asa_data.description: Apple Search Ads attribution data. Sent for iOS only.

referrers.label: Google Play Referrers
referrers.description: Google Play install referrers. Keys are remapped to the names AppsFlyer expects. Sent for Android only.

referrer.label: Referrer
referrer.description: The Google Play store referrer URL. Sent for Android and Roku only.

applicationOpened.title: Application Opened
applicationOpened.description: Report a repeat app open to AppsFlyer.

appsflyer_id.label: AppsFlyer ID
appsflyer_id.description: The AppsFlyer device identifier. If omitted, the advertising ID is used.

device_type.label: Device Type
device_type.description: The device platform. Must be `ios`, `android` or `roku`.

timestamp.label: Timestamp
timestamp.description: When the event occurred. Required — this value is part of the request signature.

ip.label: IP Address
ip.description: The device IP address. Required — this value is part of the request signature.

locale.label: Locale
locale.description: The device locale. Required — this value is part of the request signature.

advertising_id.label: Advertising ID
advertising_id.description: The device advertising ID. Sent as `idfa` on iOS and `advertising_id` on Android and Roku.

device_id.label: Device ID
device_id.description: The iOS vendor identifier, used when the advertising ID is unavailable or zeroed out.

ad_tracking_enabled.label: Ad Tracking Enabled
ad_tracking_enabled.description: Whether the user has allowed ad tracking. Sent to AppsFlyer as the `aie` flag.

device_model.label: Device Model
device_model.description: The device model, sent to AppsFlyer as `type`.

bundle_id.label: Bundle ID
bundle_id.description: The app bundle identifier. Sent for iOS only.

att.label: ATT Status
att.description: The iOS App Tracking Transparency status. Sent for iOS only.

uid.label: User ID
uid.description: Your own identifier for the user.

anonymous_id.label: Anonymous ID
anonymous_id.description: The Segment anonymous ID, used as a fallback identifier.

campaign.label: Apple Search Ads Campaign
campaign.description: Campaign attribution, mapped to AppsFlyer's Apple Search Ads fields. Sent for iOS only.

fb_cookie.label: Facebook Cookie
fb_cookie.description: The Facebook cookie associated with this user.

cid.label: Customer User ID
cid.description: Your customer user ID. AppsFlyer prefers this over the User ID when both are present.

install_date.label: Install Date
install_date.description: When this user originally installed the app. Segment cannot derive this, so it must be supplied on the event.

counter.label: App Open Counter
counter.description: The historical number of times this user has opened the app. Segment does not track this, so it must be supplied on the event.

deeplink.label: Deeplink
deeplink.description: The full deeplink URL that opened the app.

referrer.label: Referrer
referrer.description: The Google Play store referrer URL. Sent for Android and Roku only.
